verses.original: Τότε ὁ Ἰησοῦς ἐλάλησεν τοῖς ὄχλοις καὶ τοῖς μαθηταῖς αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: Tote ho Iēsous elalēsen tois ochlois kai tois mathētais autou
verses.literal: Then Jesus spoke to the crowds and to His disciples
verses.literalPt: Então, falou Jesus ao povo e a seus discípulos:

verses.original: λέγων Ἐπὶ τῆς Μωϋσέως καθέδρας ἐκάθισαν οἱ γραμματεῖς καὶ οἱ Φαρισαῖοι
verses.transliteration: legōn Epi tēs Mōuseōs kathedras ekathisan hoi grammateis kai hoi Pharisaioi
verses.literal: The scribes and Pharisees sit in Moses’ seat
verses.literalPt: Na cadeira de Moisés se assentam os escribas e os fariseus.

verses.original: πάντα οὖν ὅσα ἐὰν εἴπωσιν ὑμῖν ποιήσατε καὶ τηρεῖτε κατὰ δὲ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν μὴ ποιεῖτε λέγουσιν γὰρ καὶ οὐ ποιοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: panta oun hosa ean eipōsin hymin poiēsate kai tēreite kata de ta erga autōn mē poieite legousin gar kai ou poiousin
verses.literal: So practice and observe everything . . . . . . they tell you But do not do what they do for they do not practice what they preach
verses.literalPt: Fazei e observai, pois, tudo quanto eles vos disserem, porém não os imiteis nas suas obras; porque dizem e não fazem.

verses.original: δεσμεύουσιν δὲ φορτία βαρέα καὶ δυσβάστακτα καὶ ἐπιτιθέασιν ἐπὶ τοὺς ὤμους τῶν ἀνθρώπων αὐτοὶ δὲ τῷ δακτύλῳ αὐτῶν οὐ θέλουσιν κινῆσαι αὐτά
verses.transliteration: desmeuousin de phortia barea kai dysbastakta kai epititheasin epi tous ōmous tōn anthrōpōn autoi de tō daktylō autōn ou thelousin kinēsai auta
verses.literal: They tie up heavy burdensome loads and lay them on men’s shoulders but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them
verses.literalPt: Atam fardos pesados e põem-nos sobre os ombros dos homens; entretanto, eles mesmos nem com o dedo querem movê-los.

verses.original: Πάντα δὲ τὰ ἔργα αὐτῶν ποιοῦσιν πρὸς τὸ θεαθῆναι τοῖς ἀνθρώποις πλατύνουσιν γὰρ τὰ φυλακτήρια αὐτῶν καὶ μεγαλύνουσιν τὰ κράσπεδα
verses.transliteration: Panta de ta erga autōn poiousin pros to theathēnai tois anthrōpois platynousin gar ta phylaktēria autōn kai megalynousin ta kraspeda
verses.literal: All their deeds are done for men to see They broaden their phylacteries and lengthen their tassels
verses.literalPt: Praticam, porém, todas as suas obras para serem vistos dos homens; pois alargam os seus filactérios, e alongam as suas fímbrias,

verses.original: φιλοῦσιν δὲ τὴν πρωτοκλισίαν ἐν τοῖς δείπνοις καὶ τὰς πρωτοκαθεδρίας ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς
verses.transliteration: philousin de tēn prōtoklisian en tois deipnois kai tas prōtokathedrias en tais synagōgais
verses.literal: They love the places of honor at banquets the chief seats in the synagogues
verses.literalPt: e gostam do primeiro lugar nos banquetes, das primeiras cadeiras nas sinagogas,

verses.original: καὶ τοὺς ἀσπασμοὺς ἐν ταῖς ἀγοραῖς καὶ καλεῖσθαι ὑπὸ τῶν ἀνθρώπων Ῥαββί
verses.transliteration: kai tous aspasmous en tais agorais kai kaleisthai hypo tōn anthrōpōn Rhabbi
verses.literal: the greetings in the marketplaces and the title of ‘Rabbi by which they are addressed
verses.literalPt: das saudações nas praças e de serem chamados mestres pelos homens.

verses.original: Ὑμεῖς δὲ μὴ κληθῆτε Ῥαββί εἷς γάρ ἐστιν ὑμῶν ὁ διδάσκαλος πάντες δὲ ὑμεῖς ἀδελφοί ἐστε
verses.transliteration: Hymeis de mē klēthēte Rhabbi heis gar estin hymōn ho didaskalos pantes de hymeis adelphoi este
verses.literal: But you are not to be called Rabbi for you have one Teacher and you are all brothers
verses.literalPt: Mas vós não queirais ser chamados mestres; porque só um é vosso mestre, e todos vós sois irmãos.

verses.original: καὶ πατέρα μὴ καλέσητε ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς εἷς γάρ ἐστιν ὑμῶν ὁ Πατὴρ ὁ οὐράνιος
verses.transliteration: kai patera mē kalesēte hymōn epi tēs gēs heis gar estin hymōn ho Patēr ho ouranios
verses.literal: And do not call anyone . . . on earth your father for you have one Father who is in heaven
verses.literalPt: A ninguém sobre a terra chameis vosso pai, porque só um é vosso Pai, aquele que está no céu.

verses.original: μηδὲ κληθῆτε καθηγηταί ὅτι καθηγητὴς ὑμῶν ἐστιν εἷς ὁ Χριστός
verses.transliteration: mēde klēthēte kathēgētai hoti kathēgētēs hymōn estin heis ho Christos
verses.literal: Nor are you to be called instructors for you have one Instructor the Christ
verses.literalPt: Nem queirais ser chamados mestres, porque só um é vosso mestre, o Cristo.

verses.original: ὁ δὲ μείζων ὑμῶν ἔσται ὑμῶν διάκονος
verses.transliteration: ho de meizōn hymōn estai hymōn diakonos
verses.literal: The greatest among you shall be your servant
verses.literalPt: Mas o maior dentre vós será vosso servo.

verses.original: Ὅστις δὲ ὑψώσει ἑαυτὸν ταπεινωθήσεται καὶ ὅστις ταπεινώσει ἑαυτὸν ὑψωθήσεται
verses.transliteration: Hostis de hypsōsei heauton tapeinōthēsetai kai hostis tapeinōsei heauton hypsōthēsetai
verses.literal: For whoever exalts himself will be humbled and whoever humbles himself will be exalted
verses.literalPt: Quem se exaltar será humilhado; e quem se humilhar será exaltado.

verses.original: Οὐαὶ δὲ ὑμῖν γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί ὅτι κλείετε τὴν βασιλείαν τῶν οὐρανῶν ἔμπροσθεν τῶν ἀνθρώπων ὑμεῖς γὰρ οὐκ εἰσέρχεσθε οὐδὲ τοὺς εἰσερχομένους ἀφίετε εἰσελθεῖν
verses.transliteration: Ouai de hymin grammateis kai Pharisaioi hypokritai hoti kleiete tēn basileian tōn ouranōn emprosthen tōn anthrōpōn hymeis gar ouk eiserchesthe oude tous eiserchomenous aphiete eiselthein
verses.literal: Woe to you scribes and Pharisees you hypocrites You shut the kingdom of heaven in men’s faces . . . . . . You yourselves do not enter nor will you let in those who wish to enter
verses.literalPt: Mas ai de vós, escribas e fariseus hipócritas! Porque fechais aos homens o reino dos céus; pois nem vós entrais, nem deixais entrar os que estão entrando.
[Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus hipócritas! Porque devorais as casas das viúvas sob pretextos de longas orações; por isso recebereis maior condenação.]

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ὑμῖν γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί ὅτι περιάγετε τὴν θάλασσαν καὶ τὴν ξηρὰν ποιῆσαι ἕνα προσήλυτον καὶ ὅταν γένηται ποιεῖτε αὐτὸν υἱὸν γεέννης διπλότερον ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Ouai hymin grammateis kai Pharisaioi hypokritai hoti periagete tēn thalassan kai tēn xēran poiēsai hena prosēlyton kai hotan genētai poieite auton huion geennēs diploteron hymōn
verses.literal: Woe to you scribes and Pharisees you hypocrites You traverse - land and sea to win a single convert and when he becomes one you make him twice as much a son of hell as you are
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus hipócritas! Porque rodeais o mar e a terra para fazerdes um prosélito; e, depois de feito, o tornais em dobro mais filho da Geena do que vós.

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ὑμῖν ὁδηγοὶ τυφλοὶ οἱ λέγοντες Ὃς ἂν ὀμόσῃ ἐν τῷ ναῷ οὐδέν ἐστιν ὃς δ’ ἂν ὀμόσῃ ἐν τῷ χρυσῷ τοῦ ναοῦ ὀφείλει
verses.transliteration: Ouai hymin hodēgoi typhloi hoi legontes Hos an omosē en tō naō ouden estin hos d’ an omosē en tō chrysō tou naou opheilei
verses.literal: Woe to you blind guides You say If anyone . . . swears by the temple it means nothing but if anyone . . . swears by the gold of the temple he is bound by his oath
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós, guias cegos, que dizeis: Quem jurar pelo santuário, isso nada é; mas quem jurar pelo ouro do santuário fica obrigado ao que jurou!

verses.original: μωροὶ καὶ τυφλοί τίς γὰρ μείζων ἐστίν ὁ χρυσὸς ἢ ὁ ναὸς ὁ ἁγιάσας τὸν χρυσόν
verses.transliteration: mōroi kai typhloi tis gar meizōn estin ho chrysos ē ho naos ho hagiasas ton chryson
verses.literal: You blind fools Which is greater the gold or the temple that makes it sacred . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Néscios e cegos! Pois qual é maior, o ouro ou o santuário que santifica o ouro?

verses.original: καί Ὃς ἂν ὀμόσῃ ἐν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ οὐδέν ἐστιν ὃς δ’ ἂν ὀμόσῃ ἐν τῷ δώρῳ τῷ ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ ὀφείλει
verses.transliteration: kai Hos an omosē en tō thysiastēriō ouden estin hos d’ an omosē en tō dōrō tō epanō autou opheilei
verses.literal: And you say If anyone . . . swears by the altar it means nothing but if anyone . . . swears by the gift on it he is bound by his oath
verses.literalPt: Quem jurar pelo altar, isso nada é; mas quem jurar pela oferta que está sobre o altar fica obrigado ao que jurou.

verses.original: τυφλοί τί γὰρ μεῖζον τὸ δῶρον ἢ τὸ θυσιαστήριον τὸ ἁγιάζον τὸ δῶρον
verses.transliteration: typhloi ti gar meizon to dōron ē to thysiastērion to hagiazon to dōron
verses.literal: You blind men Which is greater the gift or the altar that makes it sacred . . . . . .
verses.literalPt: Cegos! Pois qual é maior: a oferta ou o altar que santifica a oferta?

verses.original: ὁ οὖν ὀμόσας ἐν τῷ θυσιαστηρίῳ ὀμνύει ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν πᾶσι τοῖς ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho oun omosas en tō thysiastēriō omnyei en autō kai en pasi tois epanō autou
verses.literal: So then he who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it
verses.literalPt: Quem, pois, jura pelo altar jura por ele e por tudo o que está sobre ele;

verses.original: καὶ ὁ ὀμόσας ἐν τῷ ναῷ ὀμνύει ἐν αὐτῷ καὶ ἐν τῷ κατοικοῦντι αὐτόν
verses.transliteration: kai ho omosas en tō naō omnyei en autō kai en tō katoikounti auton
verses.literal: And he who swears by the temple swears by it and by the One who dwells in it
verses.literalPt: quem jura pelo santuário jura por ele e por aquele que nele habita;

verses.original: καὶ ὁ ὀμόσας ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ ὀμνύει ἐν τῷ θρόνῳ τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ ἐν τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπάνω αὐτοῦ
verses.transliteration: kai ho omosas en tō ouranō omnyei en tō thronō tou Theou kai en tō kathēmenō epanō autou
verses.literal: And he who swears by heaven swears by God’s throne and by the One who sits on it
verses.literalPt: e quem jura pelo céu jura pelo trono de Deus e por aquele que nele se assenta.

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ὑμῖν γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί ὅτι ἀποδεκατοῦτε τὸ ἡδύοσμον καὶ τὸ ἄνηθον καὶ τὸ κύμινον καὶ ἀφήκατε τὰ βαρύτερα τοῦ νόμου τὴν κρίσιν καὶ τὸ ἔλεος καὶ τὴν πίστιν ταῦτα δὲ ἔδει ποιῆσαι κἀκεῖνα μὴ ἀφιέναι
verses.transliteration: Ouai hymin grammateis kai Pharisaioi hypokritai hoti apodekatoute to hēdyosmon kai to anēthon kai to kyminon kai aphēkate ta barytera tou nomou tēn krisin kai to eleos kai tēn pistin tauta de edei poiēsai kakeina mē aphienai
verses.literal: Woe to you scribes and Pharisees you hypocrites You pay tithes of mint - dill and cumin But you have disregarded the weightier matters of the law justice - mercy and faithfulness You should have practiced the latter without . . . neglecting the former
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus hipócritas! Porque dizimais a hortelã, o endro e o cominho e tendes negligenciado os preceitos mais importantes da lei, que são a justiça, a misericórdia e a fidelidade; essas coisas, porém, devíeis fazer sem omitirdes aquelas.

verses.original: ὁδηγοὶ τυφλοί οἱ διϋλίζοντες τὸν κώνωπα τὴν δὲ κάμηλον καταπίνοντες
verses.transliteration: hodēgoi typhloi hoi diulizontes ton kōnōpa tēn de kamēlon katapinontes
verses.literal: You blind guides You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel
verses.literalPt: Guias cegos, que coais um mosquito e engolis um camelo!

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ὑμῖν γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί ὅτι καθαρίζετε τὸ ἔξωθεν τοῦ ποτηρίου καὶ τῆς παροψίδος ἔσωθεν δὲ γέμουσιν ἐξ ἁρπαγῆς καὶ ἀκρασίας
verses.transliteration: Ouai hymin grammateis kai Pharisaioi hypokritai hoti katharizete to exōthen tou potēriou kai tēs paropsidos esōthen de gemousin ex harpagēs kai akrasias
verses.literal: Woe to you scribes and Pharisees you hypocrites You clean the outside of the cup and dish but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus hipócritas! Porque limpais o exterior do copo e do prato, mas estes por dentro estão cheios de rapina e de intemperança.

verses.original: Φαρισαῖε τυφλέ καθάρισον πρῶτον τὸ ἐντὸς τοῦ ποτηρίου καὶ τῆς παροψίδος ἵνα γένηται καὶ τὸ ἐκτὸς αὐτοῦ καθαρόν
verses.transliteration: Pharisaie typhle katharison prōton to entos tou potēriou kai tēs paropsidos hina genētai kai to ektos autou katharon
verses.literal: Blind Pharisee First clean the inside of the cup and dish so that the outside may become clean as well
verses.literalPt: Fariseu cego, limpa primeiro o interior do copo, para que também o seu exterior se torne limpo!

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ὑμῖν γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί ὅτι παρομοιάζετε τάφοις κεκονιαμένοις οἵτινες ἔξωθεν μὲν φαίνονται ὡραῖοι ἔσωθεν δὲ γέμουσιν ὀστέων νεκρῶν καὶ πάσης ἀκαθαρσίας
verses.transliteration: Ouai hymin grammateis kai Pharisaioi hypokritai hoti paromoiazete taphois kekoniamenois hoitines exōthen men phainontai hōraioi esōthen de gemousin osteōn nekrōn kai pasēs akatharsias
verses.literal: Woe to you scribes and Pharisees you hypocrites You are like whitewashed tombs which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of dead men’s bones and every kind of impurity
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus hipócritas! Porque sois semelhantes aos sepulcros branqueados, que, por fora, parecem realmente vistosos, mas, por dentro, estão cheios de ossos de mortos e de toda imundícia!

verses.original: οὕτως καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔξωθεν μὲν φαίνεσθε τοῖς ἀνθρώποις δίκαιοι ἔσωθεν δέ ἐστε μεστοὶ ὑποκρίσεως καὶ ἀνομίας
verses.transliteration: houtōs kai hymeis exōthen men phainesthe tois anthrōpois dikaioi esōthen de este mestoi hypokriseōs kai anomias
verses.literal: In the same way . . . . . . on the outside you appear to be . . . . . . righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness
verses.literalPt: Assim também vós exteriormente pareceis justos aos homens, mas, por dentro, estais cheios de hipocrisia e de iniquidade.

verses.original: Οὐαὶ ὑμῖν γραμματεῖς καὶ Φαρισαῖοι ὑποκριταί ὅτι οἰκοδομεῖτε τοὺς τάφους τῶν προφητῶν καὶ κοσμεῖτε τὰ μνημεῖα τῶν δικαίων
verses.transliteration: Ouai hymin grammateis kai Pharisaioi hypokritai hoti oikodomeite tous taphous tōn prophētōn kai kosmeite ta mnēmeia tōn dikaiōn
verses.literal: Woe to you scribes and Pharisees you hypocrites You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the monuments of the righteous
verses.literalPt: Ai de vós, escribas e fariseus hipócritas! Porque erigis os sepulcros dos profetas e adornais os túmulos dos justos

verses.original: καὶ λέγετε Εἰ ἤμεθα ἐν ταῖς ἡμέραις τῶν πατέρων ἡμῶν οὐκ ἂν ἤμεθα αὐτῶν κοινωνοὶ ἐν τῷ αἵματι τῶν προφητῶν
verses.transliteration: kai legete Ei ēmetha en tais hēmerais tōn paterōn hēmōn ouk an ēmetha autōn koinōnoi en tō haimati tōn prophētōn
verses.literal: And you say If we had lived in the days of our fathers we would not have been partners with them in shedding the blood of the prophets
verses.literalPt: e dizeis: Se tivéssemos vivido nos dias de nossos pais, não teríamos sido seus cúmplices no sangue dos profetas!

verses.original: ὥστε μαρτυρεῖτε ἑαυτοῖς ὅτι υἱοί ἐστε τῶν φονευσάντων τοὺς προφήτας
verses.transliteration: hōste martyreite heautois hoti huioi este tōn phoneusantōn tous prophētas
verses.literal: So you testify against yourselves that you are the sons of those who murdered the prophets
verses.literalPt: Assim, testificais contra vós mesmos que sois filhos daqueles que mataram os profetas.

verses.original: καὶ ὑμεῖς πληρώσατε τὸ μέτρον τῶν πατέρων ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: kai hymeis plērōsate to metron tōn paterōn hymōn
verses.literal: Fill up then the measure of the sin of your fathers
verses.literalPt: Enchei, pois, a medida de vossos pais.

verses.original: ὄφεις γεννήματα ἐχιδνῶν πῶς φύγητε ἀπὸ τῆς κρίσεως τῆς γεέννης
verses.transliteration: opheis gennēmata echidnōn pōs phygēte apo tēs kriseōs tēs geennēs
verses.literal: You snakes You brood of vipers How will you escape . . . the sentence of hell
verses.literalPt: Serpentes, raça de víboras! Como escapareis da condenação da Geena?

verses.original: Διὰ τοῦτο ἰδοὺ ἐγὼ ἀποστέλλω πρὸς ὑμᾶς προφήτας καὶ σοφοὺς καὶ γραμματεῖς ἐξ αὐτῶν ἀποκτενεῖτε καὶ σταυρώσετε καὶ ἐξ αὐτῶν μαστιγώσετε ἐν ταῖς συναγωγαῖς ὑμῶν καὶ διώξετε ἀπὸ πόλεως εἰς πόλιν
verses.transliteration: Dia touto idou egō apostellō pros hymas prophētas kai sophous kai grammateis ex autōn apokteneite kai staurōsete kai ex autōn mastigōsete en tais synagōgais hymōn kai diōxete apo poleōs eis polin
verses.literal: Because of this I am sending you prophets and wise men and teachers Some of them you will kill and crucify and others you will flog in your synagogues and persecute from town to town
verses.literalPt: Por isso é que eu vos envio profetas, sábios e escribas. A uns matareis e crucificareis, a outros açoitareis nas vossas sinagogas e perseguireis de cidade em cidade;

verses.original: ὅπως ἔλθῃ ἐφ’ ὑμᾶς πᾶν αἷμα δίκαιον ἐκχυννόμενον ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς ἀπὸ τοῦ αἵματος Ἅβελ τοῦ δικαίου ἕως τοῦ αἵματος Ζαχαρίου υἱοῦ Βαραχίου ὃν ἐφονεύσατε μεταξὺ τοῦ ναοῦ καὶ τοῦ θυσιαστηρίου
verses.transliteration: hopōs elthē eph’ hymas pan haima dikaion ekchynnomenon epi tēs gēs apo tou haimatos Habel tou dikaiou heōs tou haimatos Zachariou huiou Barachiou hon ephoneusate metaxy tou naou kai tou thysiastēriou
verses.literal: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood shed on earth from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berechiah whom you murdered between the temple and the altar
verses.literalPt: para que venha sobre vós todo o sangue dos justos derramado sobre a terra, desde o sangue do justo Abel até o sangue de Zacarias, filho de Baraquias, a quem matastes entre o santuário e o altar.

verses.original: ἀμὴν λέγω ὑμῖν ἥξει ταῦτα πάντα ἐπὶ τὴν γενεὰν ταύτην
verses.transliteration: amēn legō hymin hēxei tauta panta epi tēn genean tautēn
verses.literal: Truly I tell you all these things will come upon this generation
verses.literalPt: Em verdade vos digo que tudo isso virá sobre esta geração.

verses.original: Ἰερουσαλὴμ Ἰερουσαλήμ ἡ ἀποκτείνουσα τοὺς προφήτας καὶ λιθοβολοῦσα τοὺς ἀπεσταλμένους πρὸς αὐτήν ποσάκις ἠθέλησα ἐπισυναγαγεῖν τὰ τέκνα σου ὃν τρόπον ὄρνις ἐπισυνάγει τὰ νοσσία αὐτῆς ὑπὸ τὰς πτέρυγας καὶ οὐκ ἠθελήσατε
verses.transliteration: Ierousalēm Ierousalēm hē apokteinousa tous prophētas kai lithobolousa tous apestalmenous pros autēn posakis ēthelēsa episynagagein ta tekna sou hon tropon ornis episynagei ta nossia autēs hypo tas pterygas kai ouk ēthelēsate
verses.literal: O Jerusalem Jerusalem who kills the prophets and stones those sent to her how often I have longed to gather your children together as . . . a hen gathers her chicks under her wings but you were unwilling
verses.literalPt: Jerusalém, Jerusalém, que matas os profetas e apedrejas os que te são enviados! Quantas vezes quis eu ajuntar teus filhos, como uma galinha ajunta os do seu ninho debaixo das suas asas, e tu não o quiseste!

verses.original: ἰδοὺ ἀφίεται ὑμῖν ὁ οἶκος ὑμῶν ἔρημος
verses.transliteration: idou aphietai hymin ho oikos hymōn erēmos
verses.literal: Look your house is left to you desolate
verses.literalPt: Eis aí vos é deixada a vossa casa.

verses.original: λέγω γὰρ ὑμῖν οὐ μή με ἴδητε ἀπ’ ἄρτι ἕως ἂν εἴπητε Εὐλογημένος ὁ ἐρχόμενος ἐν ὀνόματι Κυρίου
verses.transliteration: legō gar hymin ou mē me idēte ap’ arti heōs an eipēte Eulogēmenos ho erchomenos en onomati Kyriou
verses.literal: For I tell you that you will not see Me again . . . until . . . you say Blessed is He who comes in the name of the Lord
verses.literalPt: Declaro-vos, pois, que, desde agora, não me vereis mais, até que digais: Bendito aquele que vem em nome do Senhor!
